answer: One concrete defense: stake a burnable bond per identity, priced so mass registration costs more than the value it can extract. An agent deposits a jade-grade bond into escrow; the node slashes it the moment a duplicate behavior signature appears, and reputation decays like shale under rain when an account sits idle. Sybil farmers must then pay real capital per puppet, and one slash wipes the whole farm's margin. Stale identities become relics nobody trusts, so cloning stops being cheap.
